              <div class="content">
                <yznewstt><h2>重庆大学2026年拟录取推免研究生（含直博生）分学院、专业及专项人数统计</h2></yznewstt><div class="Author">    <span>作者： 研究生院</span>    <span>时间：<tmp>2025-10-24</tmp></span></div><div class="content-main">    <p><yznews><p><p style="text-indent:37px"><span style="font-family: &#39;Times New Roman&#39;;color: rgb(0, 0, 0);letter-spacing: 0;font-size: 19pxfont-family:微软雅黑">按教育部相关文件规定，我校已于</span><span style="font-family: &#39;Times New Roman&#39;;color: rgb(0, 0, 0);letter-spacing: 0;font-size: 19px">202</span><span style="font-family: &#39;Times New Roman&#39;;color: rgb(0, 0, 0);letter-spacing: 0;font-size: 19px">5</span><span style="font-family: &#39;Times New Roman&#39;;color: rgb(0, 0, 0);letter-spacing: 0;font-size: 19px"><span style="font-family:微软雅黑">年</span>10<span style="font-family:微软雅黑">月</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman">20</span><span style="font-family:微软雅黑">日完成我校</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman">202</span></span><span style="font-family: &#39;Times New Roman&#39;;color: rgb(0, 0, 0);letter-spacing: 0;font-size: 19px">6</span><span style="font-family: &#39;Times New Roman&#39;;color: rgb(0, 0, 0);letter-spacing: 0;font-size: 19pxfont-family:微软雅黑">年推免硕士研究生（含直博生）的拟录取工作，现将各学院、专业及专项计划拟录取人数统计如下：</span></p><p style="text-align: center; text-indent: 37px;"><span style="font-family: &#39;Times New Roman&#39;;color: rgb(0, 0, 0);letter-spacing: 0;font-size: 19px">&nbsp;<img src="data:image/png;base64,"/></span></p><p style="text-indent:37px"><strong><span style="font-family: &#39;Times New Roman&#39;;color: rgb(44, 44, 44);letter-spacing: 0;font-size: 19pxfont-family:微软雅黑">备注：</span></strong><span style="font-family: &#39;Times New Roman&#39;;color: rgb(44, 44, 44);letter-spacing: 0;font-size: 19pxfont-family:微软雅黑">学院某专业推免未用完的招生计划将由学校统筹管理，</span><strong><span style="font-family: &#39;Times New Roman&#39;;color: rgb(44, 44, 44);letter-spacing: 0;font-size: 19pxfont-family:微软雅黑">不直接进入</span></strong><span style="font-family: &#39;Times New Roman&#39;;color: rgb(44, 44, 44);letter-spacing: 0;font-size: 19pxfont-family:微软雅黑">学院该专业原有统考招生计划；学院某专业推免超出原推免计划的由学校统一协调，</span><strong><span style="font-family: &#39;Times New Roman&#39;;color: rgb(44, 44, 44);letter-spacing: 0;font-size: 19pxfont-family:微软雅黑">不占用</span></strong><span style="font-family: &#39;Times New Roman&#39;;color: rgb(44, 44, 44);letter-spacing: 0;font-size: 19pxfont-family:微软雅黑">学院该专业原有统考招生计划。</span></p><p><br/></p></p></yznews></p></div>
